title: Five minutes past the timelock the lock is still LOCKED — nothing expires by itself
description: At 10:05, past the 10:00 timelock, the record still reads HTLC_STATE_LOCKED and counterparty_locked is still false. Expiry is a permission to refund, not a state transition.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway. There is no EXPIRED value in the HTLC state vocabulary and no background job that sets one, so a client must compare time_lock against its own clock — the gateway will not tell it. Same wrapping divergence as mock-pvp-hp-13: the body is the bare record, not {lock: ...}. The delivered domain also carries SETTLING and REFUNDING states that appear in no published enum; treat state as an open vocabulary and never assume the five documented values are exhaustive.
